caption: Wet footprints on a sun-baked pool deck dry in the heat, shrinking and fading from their edges.

sa.check: Wet footprints lie on a pool deck.
The prints fade from their edges inward.
The deck reads as sun-baked: bright and dry around the prints.
The dark wet area gets smaller and lighter.

pc.expect: Each print only shrinks and lightens from its thin edges inward and does not darken or spread again.
pc.fail: A print darkens again with nothing wetting it; or a print spreads outward; or a print fades and then returns; or the prints go from pale to dark.

pc.expect: The prints go by drying, in place, and no new prints appear on the dry deck.
pc.fail: A new print appears on dry deck with nobody walking there; or a print jumps to a new place on the deck; or a print vanishes at a stroke while still dark and wet; or the prints multiply.

pc.expect: The deck under each print is a shade darker while it is wet and matches the dry deck once the print is gone.
pc.fail: A print's area stays dark after the print has plainly dried; or the deck around an untouched print goes as dark as the print; or the prints show no difference from the dry deck at all.

pc.expect: The prints lie flat on the deck and any water in them soaks in or runs downhill on a slope.
pc.fail: The water in a print rises off the deck as beads that hang; or a print's water runs uphill across the deck; or a print lifts off the deck as a film; or the water in a print stands as a dome.

pc.expect: One deck; the prints stay flat marks on it and the deck keeps its surface.
pc.fail: A print becomes a hole in the deck; or the deck's surface opens up; or a print turns into another shape such as a hand print; or the deck changes into water.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The deck's colour and texture away from the prints and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The deck changes colour; or its texture changes pattern; or items around the deck rearrange.
